items.quote: Identify and remove any outliers in the "row retention time" column using the Z-score method with a Z-score threshold of 3. Provide the number of removed outliers.
items.description: 以 Z-score 方法（閾值 3，|z|>3 視為離群值）計算 "row retention time" 欄位的離群值個數，與 answer.txt 中 @removed_outliers_count 的數值比對。

items.quote: @removed_outliers_count[count] where "count" is a non-negative integer indicating the count of removed outliers.
items.description: answer.txt 必須包含 @removed_outliers_count[...] 項目，其值為非負整數。
